idea-plugin.name: SpringLens - Spring Boot RESTful API Tester
idea-plugin.description:
✨ Key Features

  • 🔍 Auto-Scan Endpoints: Instantly discovers all @RestController endpoints across all project modules.
  • ⚡ Instant DTO Sync: Generates mock JSON request bodies directly from Java DTO classes, POJOs, and Records with recursive loop protection.
  • 🌐 Spring Cloud Gateway Ready: Auto-detects Gateway routes, computes reverse routing (StripPrefix, PrefixPath, RewritePath), and preserves service context-path.
  • 🔑 Global Auth Sharing: Set Bearer JWT tokens or API Keys once and sync to all endpoints with one-click "Apply to All APIs".
  • 📁 Custom Collections: Create custom folders and manual HTTP requests to test external APIs or webhooks alongside project APIs.
  • 🔒 Trust-All Local SSL: Seamless testing for local microservices running on self-signed https://localhost certificates.
  • 💾 State Persistence: Automatically saves request params, custom headers, and payloads per-project across IDE restarts.
  • 📋 Instant cURL Export: One-click copy for ready-to-run curl commands for terminal testing.

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Open any Spring Boot project in IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. Click the SpringLens icon on the right sidebar.
  3. Select an endpoint, review the payload, and click Send!

🛠️ Compatibility

• Spring Boot: 2.x, 3.x | Spring Framework: 5.x, 6.x
• Spring Cloud: Gateway, Eureka, Consul
• Languages: Java 17+, Kotlin | Build: Maven, Gradle

💬 Issues & Feedback: GitHub Issues
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — Initial Stable Release

  • Smart AST Endpoint Scanner: Automatically discovers all Spring Boot REST endpoints across all project modules.
  • DTO Schema Generator: Instant dummy JSON template generation from Java DTO classes with loop detection and smart merge.
  • Spring Cloud Gateway Support: Intelligent URL calculation for microservices routing with StripPrefix, PrefixPath, and context-path retention.
  • Authentication Manager: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, and API Key support with one-click "Apply to All APIs" global synchronization.
  • Postman-Style Native UI: Soft word wrapping, colorful HTTP method badges, response formatting, and cURL export.
  • Trust-All SSL for Dev: Seamless local HTTPS testing without SSLHandshakeException errors.
  • State Persistence: Automatically preserves parameter inputs and testing history across IDE restarts.
